body:
## Why

The deprecated `trip_plan_from_minimal` adapter applies caller overrides via `TripPlan.model_copy(update=...)` without re-validation, so invalid `trip_id`, `status`, and transport values become trusted `TripPlan` instances.

`src/travel_plan_permission/conversion.py:36-50` builds `overrides` then returns `plan_input.plan.model_copy(update=overrides)` without `TripPlan.model_validate`. On tip, `trip_plan_from_minimal(payload, trip_id=None, status="not-a-status")` returns a plan with `trip_id is None` and `status == "not-a-status"`.

## Scope

Validate overrides applied by `trip_plan_from_minimal` without expanding its public surface.

## Non-Goals

Do not remove `trip_plan_from_minimal`; callers still migrate to `load_trip_plan_input`.

No scaffolding or TODO-only changes.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `src/travel_plan_permission/conversion.py:50` to validate the `model_copy(update=overrides)` result with `TripPlan.model_validate(...)` or an equivalent validated rebuild.
- [ ] Keep the deprecation warning and public surface of `trip_plan_from_minimal` unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `tests/python/test_minimal_conversion.py::test_trip_plan_from_minimal_validates_overrides` verifies that `trip_id=None` and `status="not-a-status"` raise `ValidationError`.
- [ ] Restoring unvalidated `model_copy` causes `tests/python/test_minimal_conversion.py::test_trip_plan_from_minimal_validates_overrides` to fail; reverting restores a passing test.

## Implementation Notes

Reproduction:

```python
import json, warnings
from pathlib import Path
from travel_plan_permission.conversion import trip_plan_from_minimal
payload = json.loads(Path("tests/fixtures/sample_trip_plan_minimal.json").read_text())
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
    p = trip_plan_from_minimal(payload, trip_id=None, status="not-a-status")
print(p.trip_id, p.status)  # None not-a-status
```

Surfaced by Track D repo-audit 2026-09-23; verified on clone tip.
